notes.title: Patch Update, Future of Crest and Future of ECS
notes.notes:
[url=https://imgur.com/ilm4OkZ][img]http://i.imgur.com/ilm4OkZ.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Summary[/h1]
We have the past month been working on a patch to fix the most serious issues with Crest and to give it some love before we move on to the next exciting project (more on that below). Unfortunately we haven’t been able to save your old save files (sorry).



[h1]Patch Update[/h1]

[b]Major Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] The major bug causing the majority of the saving errors has been fixed.
[*] Fixed the bug that blocked players from upgrading expertise buildings.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused followers not to be able to mine mines.
[*] The water consumption has been balanced so that it will be much harder to get desert islands.
[/list]


[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with completing achievements.
[*] Fixed the issue that caused mini map clips to be skipped.
[*] Visual bugs for Mac has been fixed.
[*] Fixed the issue with UI elements being triggered by hotkeys while being in menu or saving.
[*] Fixed the camera so it doesn’t forget the last position when switching between scenes.
[*] The bug causing animations for all living things in the game get stuck in one short loop has been fixed.
[*] Re-connect to Twitch is now working.
[*] A bug causing the prompt “Write a commandment!” to get stuck has been fixed.
[*] A bug causing the word “socialise” not to raise social need is now fixed
[*] And other smaller bug fixes.
[/list]


[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance fixes.
[*] Added new Steam achievements.
[*] Teachings that were almost impossible to complete has been balanced to be easier.
[*] A follower can no longer die of starvation if the city has plenty of food unless they are starving themselves due to commandments or interpretations.
[*] Condemn is now more effective.
[*] If the player clicks on a city nameplate it now opens the city UI window.
[*] Added a popup that tells the player if a save or load error has occurred.
[*] Faith meter in World Overview UI window is added.
[*] A new speech bubble has been added that shows the player when a follower is following an interpreted commandment.
[*] The misfortune: “Dry rivers” do not happen as frequently anymore.
[*] And other smaller improvements.
[/list]



[h1]Moving On[/h1]
The game is now complete, there will be no major updates to the game. The reason is that the game has sold a lot less than we would need to make the development cost back. We have sold around 14 000 copies since we entered Early Access back in 2015, we would need to sell around 50 000 copies to even make back the development cost. Compared to how much games on Steam sell in general we did better! But that's because [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/gdcs-realistic-talk-about-game-sales-on-steam-paints-a-grim-picture/]the average is 2000[/url] copies, which no one can live on.

The relaunch in December, 2018 was our way to fix the game, since we think you, our fans, deserved a better game. But it was also an attempt to make Crest more appealing and get a second life and sell more. If the game would've sold better we could've continued with updates. But the relaunch didn't give us huge numbers to encourage more development time.

So it's a simple answer, we didn't earn a lot of money and working more on the game would only drive us into bankruptcy, we have to eat too. :)


[h1]Next Thing: Among Ripples 2[/h1]
A small team at our studio has been working on a prototype for [b]Among Ripples 2[/b], our upcoming sequel to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/341720/Among_Ripples/]first game[/url]. It will be an ambitious management tycoon game where you shape lakes and oceans, ravaged by pollution, and make them habitable for fish and other animals.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ljG5gCR.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/uFYZXzb.png[/img]




We're pitching the project to publishers and investors right now and hope we will be going into full development within a few months, until then we do contract work to stay afloat. We will be releasing a new trailer for the prototype really soon, here's the old one we have used to pitch the game.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z1XDRuKvov0


[h1]Support for Crest in the Future[/h1]
We will keep an eye on the game and if you find game breaking bugs or balancing issues that completely break the game experience we will patch that of course. But there will be no new features.


[h1]Follow the Development[/h1]
If you want to keep tabs on the future of our studio you can do so by joining our other social media:

https://twitter.com/AmongRipples
https://twitter.com/EatCreateSleep
https://www.facebook.com/eatcreatesleep/
https://discordapp.com/invite/ecs
https://www.youtube.com/user/eatcreatesleep


Right now we mainly use our Discord to talk about Among Ripples 2.



[h1]Thank You![/h1]
Making Crest has been a wild ride, we have learned a lot, and the game would not be half as good without your feedback. Thank you for your support and patience. We hope that your time in Crest was worthwhile and that you would want to support our future games.


//Martin & Eat Create Sleep Team

notes.title: Hotfix, Vacation and Winter Sale
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x5ihB2k.png[/img]


Hey,


The new hotfix is live to fix the most irritating bugs, we will be going away for vacation until the 10th January, during the rest of January we will be fixing the things we didn't have time for before the holidays.

Crest is also on the Winter sale during this time, so tell your friends, and leave a good review if you like it. ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/341710/Crest__an_indirect_god_sim/


[h1]Hotfix[/h1]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with followers not migrating to the coast.
[*] Fixed harbours not appearing for some cities close to coasts.
[*] Fixed diplomats not spawning when cities should create alliances.
[*] Fixed tooltips showing wrong texts in the main options menu.
[*] Fixed a non-working Steam achievement.
[*] Fixed issue with Expertise buildings not being able to upgrade, resulting in max 4 city districts.
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] The word ‘Socialize’ is unlockable earlier in Book of Learning.
[*] If you choose to terraform, you will no longer be spammed with Bulletin Messages.
[*] You can no longer open the Word Tablet and the Wisdom Tablet when your legacy has ended.
[*] Longer time between tutorial nudges.
[*] UI polish
[/list]


[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changelog line breaks are a bit “off”.
[*] Twitch integration reconnect not working.
[*] Interpretation bulletin message calling it “association”
[*] Graveyard visual issues with certain history events.
[*] Insatiable hunger animal effect does not disappear sometimes.
[*] Some UI elements can be accessed after the game has ended.
[*] Sometimes, creating commandments in loaded games can cause them to be free of cost and the Word Tablet is not cleared after proclaiming them.
[*] In rare cases, saves won’t work. 
[*] For some, the Mini-Cinematics doesn’t work in the minimap.
[*] Sometimes, in loaded games, the animations for followers and animals won’t play correctly.
[*] You can't give up and quit in the underworld.
[*] Saving during the tutorial will corrupt your save file. 
[*] Spelling errors
[/list]



---


See you all in 2019, thanks for the support.


[b]Happy holidays![/b]
//Martin and ECS

notes.notes:

notes.title: Update - New Content After Summer!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Thanks to all of the great feedback you've given us since launch we feel we need to do the product justice and increase longevity and replayability. This is not a small feat however, and we will need several months to fix it.

We're currently building the new features for Crest's grand update that will arrive after the summer, before then we will need testers. If anyone is up for it join our Discord and let us know!

http://discord.gg/ecs 


When the update looms closer you will be the first to know of a launch date.


Thank you for your continued support and patience!
//Martin & Eat Create Sleep

notes.title: New Update Coming Soon - Improving End Game
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We've gotten a lot of feedback as of late that the game lacks goals or enough meaningful end game content. This is always a conflict when making sandbox games, if you narrow the goals too much it's not much of a sandbox anymore, but if you make it too loose then some people feel they lack motivation.

We're going to find a better balance. So in the end of the summer we will release a new update that builds upon what we already have. The gist of it is that you will be able to shape the religion in more direct ways, for example eliminating some doctrines and having permanent effects on the religion you're building. The underworld and ancestors will provide an important role here.

We still believe Crest can reach more people and have not lost hope in making it the best it can be with the resources we have. The team is really excited about these new features and think it will solve a lot of the problems people have given us feedback about.

---

Before the new update goes live you can help us in some simple but important ways:

* Leave a positive review if you like the game
* Share the game to your friends
* Ask your favourite streamers to play the game (Twitch support)



Thank you for your continued support!
// Martin & The Eat Create Sleep Team

notes.title: Inheritors Update Now Live! Baby Animals - Custom Games - Twitch Integration
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jo80KMj.gif[/img]

We've secretly been working on a major update and are very happy to now finally be able to present it to you: the Inheritors Update, a free, automatic update for all players on all platforms, available RIGHT NOW!

[h1]New features[/h1]
[list][*][b]Baby animals[/b] – Animals now have babies!
[*][b]Custom Games[/b] – You can now customize your games with increased or decreased amounts of resources, animals, islands and overall island quality.
[*][b]Twitch integration[/b] – Built in twitch support now allows streamers to engage their viewers in the actual game! Join cities and vote on commandments to help or disrupt the streamer's plans.
[*][b]Increased selection[/b] – Resources and animals are now selectable and include detailed descriptions.[/list]
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list][*][b]Associations logic[/b] - Only one word will now be changed when a new association is made with heavier focus on similar words.
[*][b]War implications[/b] – Cities who win a conflict will now pillage and kill followers of the losing city
[*][b]Feedback icons[/b] – Traders, diplomats, priests and warriors going to war now have icons above their heads to make them easier to discover.
[*][b]City and follower scrolling[/b] – You can now easily scroll between your cities by selecting one and clicking the arrows in the city popup. This also applies to all of your followers within the same city.
[*][b]Last follower death[/b] – If a follower is the last remaining follower in the world, a meter will start counting down until its death unless you actively attempt to rebuild society via commandments.
[*][b]Tutorial skip[/b] – A prompt will ask if you wish to play the tutorial in the beginning of a new game if you had the option activated, declining will turn off the tutorial setting.
[*][b]Improved death symbols[/b] – Death symbols will now be easier to spot and give a summary of what killed the followers
[*][b]Migration[/b] – All followers no longer immediately leave the city for the new, leaving the old city with just one follower.
[*][b]General feedback updates[/b] – We have added more tooltips and visual updates to minor things that happen in the game.
[*][b]Profanity filter[/b] – Has been removed completely.
[*][b]Biomes[/b] – Ground blending between biomes has been smoothed out
[*]Other minor updates[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Boats no longer move slowly in higher game speeds
[*]Mountains no longer spawn on lower areas, cutting off rivers from flowing to the ocean and turning entire islands into desert
[*]Trees should no longer occasionally turn blue
[*]Other minor bug fixes[/list]
Should you encounter any bugs, please continue submitting them via in-game function. For feedback or general questions, you're always welcome to hit us up on [b]Discord[/b]:

http://discord.gg/ecs

Thank you all for your support & have fun playing! 

Cheers,
Eat Create Sleep

notes.title: Patch Roundup v1.1 & v1.2
notes.notes:
We are very busy with working through your submitted bug reports and just pushed another patch. Thanks for being so active in reporting the bugs and please keep them coming!

Here are the patch notes of the two recent patches we pushed since launch last Thursday:

[h1]Patch Notes v1.2[/h1]
[list][*]Balance changes
    [list][*]Influence gain rebalanced: faithful cities now reward 3 influence points instead of 2.
    [*]Follower food and hunger rebalanced.
    [*]Animal fertility rebalanced.[/list]
[*]Hippos are now less aggressive. They build up anger over time instead of attacking habitat intruders immediately.
[*]Follower hut positions slightly adjusted.
[*]Tooltips should no longer display a follower death message regardless of what is hovered over.
[*]Fixed an issue with followers resting outside of their huts after running away from animals.
[*]Fixed an issue with the tutorial not being possible to complete.
[*]Fixed minor GUI navigation issues.
[*]Fixed an issue where followers could get stuck in their huts forever after the Farm word had been unlocked.[/list]

[h1]Patch Notes v1.1[/h1]
[list][*]Huts and ores now always touch the ground when spawned on slopes.
[*]Words no longer gets stuck if you alt-tab the game while dragging a word.
[*]Fixed issue with herbivores migrating after loading a saved game.
[*]Fixed problem with some followers spawning at the wrong position after loading.
[*]Trade cows now work correctly after a load.
[*]Burning mines are now destroyed properly and can be rebuilt by miners later.
[*]Miners no longer build on ores without enough chunks.
[*]64-bit version for Windows is now available.
[*]City association bubbles are now above the city name plate to stop them from being obscured by tall cities.[/list]

notes.title: Crest Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/as0vnZ3.png[/img]

The day has come. After four years in development, Version 1.0 of Crest is here!

A huge thank you to everyone who supported Crest during this long road and improved the game with their feedback and suggestions.

Crest has changed so much over the years and we're really proud of where it is now. But, Crest is also a game where new features can always be added, with endless possibilities, and we want to keep expanding the game with your ideas for as long as possible.

In order to do so, Crest has to do well during the next few weeks, otherwise we just can't afford to continue working on it. We've put together a list on how you could help us during this important time:

http://eatcreatesleep.net/supportcrest

We'll talk soon about our post-launch plans, until then, thank you again to every single god of you for supporting us. <3

Cheers,
Eat Create Sleep

https://youtu.be/R5WiMM2gYa8

[h1]v1.0 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h1]Nature[/h1]
[list][*][b]Mountains[/b] - Rain clouds gather at the mountains and snow, the snow indicates the possibility for the mountains to create rivers, as long as enough water has gathered.
[*][b]Ecology[/b] - A new water system making nature more alive. It is a delicate balance that can be affected by animals, followers, cities, farms and berry bushes.  
[*][b]Berry bushes[/b] - An early game food source making surviving in the beginning easier.
[*][b]Season changes[/b] - Once per cycle there’s a dry season or a rain season. 
[*][b]Start island does not have a volcanic biome[/b] - To promote moving to another island, the start island does not contain any volcanic biome or obsidian anymore. In order to complete monuments cities need to trade with each other. [/list]

[h1]Cities[/h1]
[list][*][b]Doctrine updated[/b] - The doctrines are updated to be more different from each other. How each doctrine reacts to commandments is updated as well. 
[*][b]Overpopulation more severe[/b] - Overpopulation can cause potentially disastrous outcomes if left alone. It costs more food and it drains more water from the surrounding area.  
[*][b]City needs[/b] - City needs are visually updated, displaying the needs in another way. 
[*][b]Doctrine/Faith mashup[/b] - Doctrine and local faith in the city popup are combined to one tab to provide a quicker & easier overview.
[*][b]Expertise buildings[/b] - Diplomacy, War and Trading have now their own expertise buildings.
[*][b]Needs renamed[/b] - Some of the city are renamed for convenience. 
[list][*]Fellowship = Social
[*]Sustenance = Food
[*]Abundance = Surplus
[*]Wealth = Money[/list] [/list]

[h1]Followers[/h1]
[list][*][b]Self preservation[/b] - Followers now try to avoid dangerous areas (animal habitats) and attempt to run away when attacked.
[*][b]More own will feedback[/b] - The feedback given when followers act on their own will is now more detailed.
[*][b]Stamina fixes[/b] - Followers are now getting properly tired when doing any work so that they can’t keep going forever.[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list][*][b]World Overview[/b] - A new UI window details all cities and their overall needs, number of inhabitants, doctrine, faith and strength in war.
[*][b]Word Discovery[/b] - A new system for discovering words in the game, now in the shape of a tech tree that gives you an overview of all of the words and how to unlock them.
[*][b]Faith[/b]  - No longer counts followers but cities instead.
[*][b]Mini-Map[/b] - A small update to the mini-map marker so that it’s easier to tell where you are.
[*][b]Updated Tutorial[/b] - The tutorial is updated to account for all new features that have been added to the game.
[*][b]Achievements[/b] - A whole bunch of Steam achievements are added.
[*][b]Polished visuals[/b] - New shaders to make it look extra shiny.
[/list]

[h1]Commandment and Word Tablet[/h1]
[list][*][b]Commandments[/b] - Many of the commandment combinations are iterated and changed, adding some completely new ones such as “scare away animals” and we also make the consume verb have less “cannibalistic” outcomes.

[*][b]City Creation[/b] - Followers no longer create cities on their own, and must be ordered to do so via migration commandments.
[*][b]Word tablet[/b] - The word tablet gets an UI overhaul to match the new word discovery system.

[*][b]Commandment tablet[/b] - In addition to the bless/condemn of the associations, the original commandment can now be blessed and condemned as well. Blessing the original commandment will increase the lifespan of that commandment for a period of time, it can be done a couple of times. Condemning an original commandment makes an association do more “damage” than it usually would to the lifebar and it also decreases the faith of your followers. These actions cost two influence.[/list]

[*][b]City Creation[/b] - Followers no longer create cities on their own, and must be ordered to do so via migration commandments.
[*][b]Word tablet[/b] - The word tablet gets an UI overhaul to match the new word discovery system.

[*][b]Commandment tablet[/b] - In addition to the bless/condemn of the associations, the original commandment can now be blessed and condemned as well. Blessing the original commandment will increase the lifespan of that commandment for a period of time, it can be done a couple of times. Condemning an original commandment makes an association do more “damage” than it usually would to the lifebar and it also decreases the faith of your followers. These actions cost two influence.[/list]

notes.title: Spot hippos and explore new islands in Crest update
notes.notes:
You’re no longer restricted to controlling a single island in early access god game Crest [official site]: the latest update means your followers can sail off to explore the world around them. If you didn’t know, Crest is a religion simulator in which you can only interact with your subjects by issuing vague commandments in the if [subject] then [verb] [object] form. They’re supposed to be ambiguous, and it’s unlikely your people will do want you want them to do. Most likely, they’ll die of starvation, but hey-ho, you can just fire up another procedurally-generated world and start again.

The update, which adds an ‘Exploration Module’, is full of stuff. As well as getting in boats and heading for new shores, your followers can terraform land. Island variety is up (there’s now beaches, cliffs and harbours), and there’s new commandments to try out. Oh, and you’ll now spot hippos in the water, which is surely the biggest addition. Read the full list (which is somewhat vague itself) here.

(more…)

notes.title: Ancestor Worship Update is Live
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/dr6hgos.png[/img]

The Ancestors Worship update is LIVE, go check it out! 

The Ancestor Worship update introduces the Underworld, where the ancestors' spirits go to rest. They will record the player's history and advise on how to proceed with your people. The new release also features improvements to demographical mechanics and how language is developed.



[h1]Patch Notes - Version 0.42 - 16th December 2016[/h1]

[b]Features[/b]

[b]Underworld[/b]
The underworld is a new addition to the world where the advisors and chronicler reside.

[b]Advisors[/b]
They appear in the Underworld and are there to give advice to players about the likes and dislikes of the different doctrines.

[b]Chronicler[/b]
The chronicler is there to tell the player what has happened since they started the game. It records each event that has happened.

[b]Faith association[/b]
With the rework of this, associations has gone from a global level to a city level, so that each city can have their own association. Each commandment has a life bar, if the commandment is associated it will decrease the bar slightly and when that bar is empty the commandment will disappear. It’s also possible if the player doesn’t like an association to sacrifice some faith to remove it.

[b]Priests[/b]
Priests now convinces cities to follow a certain interpretation of a commandment instead of converting them to the same doctrine.



[b]Demographic[/b]

- Follower selection screen

By clicking on a follower you will be able to see information about that follower. There’s also an snap-to-follower feature in the selection screen.


- Individuality (needs, storage)

Each follower now have their own needs that will affect their actions. They have their own storage as well instead of a huge one in the city. This will mean that there will be some followers who have more food than others. They can distribute it with those who need it or be greedy and keep it for themselves.


- City Needs rework

A change to this was that there now is a limit to how many points that can be active on the spider chart. So it will not fill the entire chart anymore and be more useful for the player to gather data.


- City names

Cities now have names, they consist of the city symbol and a random word for the location the city is in, e.g. Turtle Sands (symbol + desert).


- Overpopulation

Before when one of the followers had a baby it went straight into adulthood and to a new hut. Now they first become a baby in a crib by the followers hut and it grows up before it leaves and builds another hut. If there are no room in the city they will live with their parents until a hut spot becomes available. Followers can have a maximum of 3 children at the same time. The number of children affects how much food a household consumes.


[b]Word Progression[/b]

- Word discovery

Instead of starting with all the words, the followers will discover words as they explore and experience them.


- Unaffected symbol

It is now more apparent when a commandment doesn’t affect anyone so the player knows it before they get frustrated. It’s indicated by a huge red cross.


- Notifications

If something happens on the commandment tablet while it’s closed, a notification will appear on the panel in the left corner. For instance if an association is made or a commandment disappears.


- New words: Trade, farm, socialize.


- New verbs - explore/don’t explore


[b]Social Aspects[/b]

- Fellowship

In the city needs resources has been replaced by fellowship. Fellowship is gained through social actions and it makes people happy.


- Socialisers

Socialiser is a new type of worker that socialise.


[b]Explorer[/b]
Explorer is a new type of worker that explores the world.


[b]Updated Tutorial[/b]
The tutorial has been updated with new panels and objectives for the new content.


[b]Word Tablet[/b]
[list]
[*]Added tabs for undiscovered words and discovered words.
[*]Creation helper was moved down and is now a [?] in the word tablet.
[*]Commandment subtitles now show what the commandment does instead of just words.[/list]


[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Bigger Islands
[*]More stable fps (fewer lag spikes)
[*]Improved cities (they look more fancy and varied)
[*]New menu
[*]Improved zoom smoothing.
[*]Load button disabled when there are no saves available.  
[*]Added an option to disable the creation helper in the options menu.
[*]Tweaked followers own will.
[*]Antelope walking animation changed.
[*]Cycle is now properly displayed in Calendar
[*]Added Highlight to the affected city when hovering over a city symbol in the commandment tablet. [/list]

notes.title: Update Postponed to 16th December
notes.notes:
Hello all,

The update goes online on the 16th December, two weeks later than what we promised. 

We regret to inform you this, but the postponement of the update is due to sickness. A few in the team, and especially the programmers have been affected, by flu and other things. notes.title: Hotfix - V. 0.28
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We have just uploaded a hotfix to the latest AI build. Thanks for all the bug reports, they helped us pinpoint the problem with saving and loading bugs. You should now be able to save and load without problems. Though, saves from version 0.26 and older does not work any more.

We've also added a quick fix for balancing; the followers are now less likely to hunt lions on their own (you have to order them).

We will now resume the work on the big City States module, hopefully we will release it before the new year.
